title: Ukuqokelela amanzi
description: Imisele (swales), i-berm, amadama, iitanki zamanzi emvula nee-greywater — yenza amanzi ahambe kancinci, asasazeke aze angene emhlabeni, lonke ithonsi.

lessons.title: Imisele ne-berm: ukunciphisa ijubane lamanzi ethambekeni
lessons.body:
Olunye uhlobo lomsele (swale) yimijelo elinganayo elandela umgca wokuphakama. Unciphisa ijubane lamanzi agelekayo aze awasasaze, ukuze amanzi athile afunxeke emhlabeni ofanelekileyo. Eminye imisele yenzelwe ukuba nethambeka elincinci elilawulweyo ukuze iphathe amanzi agqithisileyo iwasingise kancinci kwindawo ekhuselekileyo apho aphumela khona. Eyiphi indlela efanelana nomhlaba wakho ixhomekeke kumhlaba, kwithambeka, ekuphumeni kwamanzi nasekuhambeni kwamanzi esaqhwithi. Cela umcebisi wasekuhlaleni oqeqeshiweyo ahlole umgca, indlela yokuphuphuma kwamanzi nendawo awafikela kuyo phambi kokuba umbe.

Umhlaba okhutshiweyo ekumbeni wenza i-berm (umqolo womhlaba) ngakwicala eliya ezantsi, apho kunokutyalwa khona imithi xa uyilo lwendawo lufanelekile.

Imithi etyalwe apho isenokusebenzisa ukufuma okugcinwe emhlabeni emva kwemvula, kuxhomekeke kwindawo.

Imvula enkulu isenokugcwalisa umsele ngokukhawuleza kunokuba amanzi afunxeke emhlabeni. Cwangcisa indlela ekhuselekileyo yokuphuphuma kwamanzi phambi kokuba umbe.

Indlela yamanzi mayingawonakalisi ithambeka okanye ithumele amanzi anokonakalisa kummelwane. Umsele okanye idama elingezantsi kufuneka likwazi ukuwamkela ngokukhuselekileyo.

Cela umcebisi wasekuhlaleni oqeqeshiweyo ahlole umhlaba, ithambeka nokuhamba kwamanzi esaqhwithi. Umfanekiso awuyonto yoyilo lokwakha.

Ithambeka lodwa alikuxeleli ukuba umsele ufanelekile okanye hayi. Umhlaba, ukuphuma kwamanzi, umhlaba ongazinzanga namanzi asuka ngaphezulu entabeni konke kuyabaluleka.

Gcina umhlaba ugqunyiwe kakuhle. Funa uvavanyo lwasekuhlaleni phambi kokumba emhlabeni otsiba kakhulu, onamanzi okanye ongazinzanga. Imiqobo yengca nezitebhisi zomhlaba (iitheresi) nazo zifuna uyilo olufanele indawo.
keyPoints: Umsele olinganayo olandela umgca wokuphakama unokubamba amanzi agelekayo ukuze afunxeke kwindawo efanelekileyo; eminye imisele ifuna ithambeka eliyilelweyo nendawo ekhuselekileyo yokuphuma kwamanzi
Gcina umhlaba ugqunyiwe kakuhle kwaye ucwangcise indlela ekhuselekileyo yokuphuphuma kwamanzi
Vavanya umhlaba, ukuphuma kwamanzi, ithambeka nokuhamba kwamanzi esaqhwithi phambi kokumba

quiz.q: Umfama ucwangcise umsele olinganayo olandela umgca wokuphakama. Emva kwemvula enkulu, esinye isiphelo sibamba amanzi amaninzi. Kufuneka umfama ajonge ntoni phambi kokuba atshintshe umsebenzi wokumba?
options: Ukuba umjelo unokwenziwa ubunzulu ngakumbi ngaphandle kokuhlolwa kwendawo
Uyilo olwenzelwe nokuphakama okulinganisiweyo, kunye nomcebisi wasekuhlaleni oqeqeshiweyo; kusenokubakho indawo esezantsi engenzelwanga
Ukuba idama elitsha kwindawo esezantsi kakhulu liya kubamba konke ukuphuphuma kwamanzi
Ukuba umhlaba kufuneka uxinezelwe ukuze kuyekwe konke ukungena kwamanzi
quiz.rationale: Uyilo olulinganayo olandela umgca wokuphakama kufuneka lusasaze amanzi ubude balo bonke. Ukugcwala ngokungalinganiyo kungabonisa indawo esezantsi engenzelwanga, kodwa eminye imisele yenzelwe ngokuthambeka ukuya kwindawo ekhuselekileyo yokuphuma. Jonga uyilo lokwenyani, umhlaba nendlela yokuphuphuma kwamanzi phambi kokuyitshintsha.

quiz.q: Umfama ufuna ukulawula ukukhukuliseka komhlaba ethambekeni elitsiba kakhulu. Kufuneka enze ntoni phambi kokumba?
options: Imisele eqhelekileyo emiwe nzulu kangangoko
Gcina umhlaba ugqunyiwe kwaye ufumane uvavanyo lwendawo lokulawula ukukhukuliseka okufanelekileyo
Idama elikhulu ezantsi lokubamba onke amanzi agelekayo
Ukuxinezela ubuso bomhlaba ngerola
quiz.rationale: Ithambeka lodwa alanelisi ukukhetha umsebenzi wokumba. Umhlaba, ukuphuma kwamanzi, ukuzinza nokuhamba kwamanzi esaqhwithi kufuneka nako kuvavanywe.

lessons.infographicAlt: Umfanekiso wombono wecandelo lomsele olinganayo olandela umgca wokuphakama, unomqolo womhlaba ophakamileyo ngezantsi kwawo. Imicibisholo ibonisa amanzi agelekayo enciphisa ijubane aze asasazeke; ukungena emhlabeni kuxhomekeke kumhlaba nasendaweni.

lessons.title: Amadama namachibi efama: ukugcina amanzi ixesha lokoma
lessons.body:
Idama okanye ichibi lingagcina amanzi agelekayo, kodwa inani elifumanekayo lixhomekeke kwimvula yasekuhlaleni, indawo ekhuphela amanzi (catchment), ilahleko yamanzi nokuba usebenzisa amanzi amaninzi kangakanani.

Amaxesha emvula ayahluka kuyo yonke iMzantsi Afrika. Sebenzisa iirekhodi zasekuhlaleni kwaye ucwangcise amaxesha omileyo; akukho sithembiso sokuba idama liya kuhlala ligcwele.

Phambi kokutshintsha umjelo wamanzi okanye ukwakha imisebenzi yokugcina amanzi, jonga imvume efunekayo kwigunya lamanzi.

Idama lifuna uphando lwendawo noyilo olwenziwa ngumntu oqeqeshelwe oko ngokufanelekileyo. Amanzi agelekayo kwindawo ekhuphela amanzi, umhlaba, iziseko, umngcipheko ongezantsi nendlela ekhuselekileyo yokuphuphuma kwamanzi (spillway) konke kuyabaluleka.

Musa ukucinga ukuba imvula yonyaka ikuxelela ubukhulu bomkhukula okanye amanzi aya kuba nawo egcinwe.

Ukuphuphuma okungalawulwanga kunokukhukulisa kwaye kuqhekeze udonga. Cwangcisa indlela ekhuselekileyo yamanzi agqithisileyo phambi kokwakha.

Amanzi anokulahleka ngokuhwamla nangokuvuza emhlabeni. Jonga ukuphakama kwamanzi kwaye ufune ukuvuza okanye ukukhukuliseka.

Gcina indlela yokuphuphuma ingavaliwe kwaye ugcine ukugqunywa kwamabhanki njengoko kumiselwe kuyilo. Musa ukutyala imithi kudonga ledama lomhlaba.

Izilwanyana zingonakalisa amabhanki kwaye zongeze ubulongwe emanzini. Ubukho bazo abwenzi amanzi acocekileyo okanye akhuselekileyo.
keyPoints: Idama lifuna uvavanyo lwendawo noyilo olwenziwe ngumntu oqeqeshelwe oko
Yila indlela ekhuselekileyo yokuphuphuma kwamanzi (spillway) phambi kokwakha
Jonga iimvume zamanzi ezifunekayo phambi kokwakha
Gcina ukugqunywa kwamabhanki kwaye ungatyali mithi kudonga ledama lomhlaba

quiz.q: Umfama wakha udonga ledama ngaphandle kwendlela yokuphuphuma. Emva kwesaqhwithi esingaqhelekanga, liyaphuphuma. Kuya kuba yintoni isiphumo esinokwenzeka?
options: Amanzi ankcenkceshela amasimi aphantsi ngendlela enenzuzo
Adlula phezu kodonga aze alukhukulise, kubekho umngcipheko wokuqhekeka okubi kakhulu
Idama lihlala ligcwele kwaye ukuphuphuma kuhamba ngokungenabungozi
Umthamo wokugcina uyanda ngokusisigxina
quiz.rationale: Ngaphandle kwendlela eyilelweyo yokuphuphuma, amanzi agqithisileyo azifunela indlela phezu kodonga — kwaye ukuhamba okungalawulwanga yikho okukhukulisa aze ekugqibeleni aluqhekeze.

quiz.q: Sesiphi isenzo esinceda ukukhusela idama lomhlaba?
options: Idama elinzulu, elingagqunywanga, elingenazityalo ebhankini
Gcina ukugqunywa kwamabhanki okuyilelweyo kwaye ugcine indlela yokuphuphuma ingavaliwe
Ukwaleka ngekhonkrithi epheleleyo nangeplastiki
Umphezulu omkhulu ukuze ukuhwamla kusasazeke ngokulinganayo
quiz.rationale: Indlela yokuphuphuma engavaliwe namabhanki agcinwe kakuhle kunceda idama lisebenze njengoko liyilelwe. Imithi ayimele ityalwe kudonga ledama lomhlaba.

lessons.infographicAlt: Idama lefama lisikwe embindini: amanzi engena kwesinye isiphelo, umzimba wamanzi agciniweyo, indlela yokuphuphuma (spillway) ephezulu emphethweni wokuphuma kwamanzi agqithisileyo, nebhanki etyaliweyo ibambe umhlaba.

lessons.title: Iitanki zamanzi emvula nokuqokelelwa ophahleni: ukuqokelela nokukhusela amanzi
lessons.body:
Uphahla lwakho lunokuqokelela amanzi emvula. Inani lixhomekeke kubungakanani bophahla, kwimvula nakwilahleko.

Jonga ukuba izinto zophahla zifanelekile na ekuqokeleleni amanzi emvula phambi kokuqhagamshela itanki.

Sebenzisa ubungakanani bophahla njengoko buboniwa ngaphezulu kunye neerekhodi zemvula zasekuhlaleni. Emva koko linganisa amanzi angaphumeliyo emjelweni wophahla (igatara), aphambukiswayo okanye aphuphuma kwitanki egcweleyo.

Isixa semvula yonyaka asikuxeleli ukuba mangaphi amanzi aya kubakho ngexesha lokoma. Thelekisa amanzi onawo nokusetyenziswa okucwangcisileyo.

Amanzi asuka ophahleni anokuthwala uthuli, ubulongwe nokunye ukungcola. I-first-flush diverter (isixhobo esiphambukisa amanzi okuqala) igcina inxalenye yamanzi okuqala ingangeni kwitanki.

Ubungakanani bamanzi afuneka aphambukiswe buxhomekeke kuphahla nakwinkqubo. Sebenzisa imiyalelo yomthengisi yobungakanani nokugcinwa; akukho mthamo mnye ofanele zonke izophahla.

I-diverter ayiwenzi amanzi asele afanelekile ukusela.

Ubungakanani betanki buxhomekeke kwimfuno yamanzi, imvula, ubungakanani bophahla nobude bamaxesha omileyo.

Bhala ukusetyenziswa oceba ukukwenza uze uqikelele imfuno yako usebenzisa iirekhodi zakho. Thelekisa oko namanzi onawo ngamaxesha onyaka.

Cwangcisa into oya kuyenza xa amanzi agciniweyo ancipha. Igama lephondo ngokwalo alinakukuxelela ubungakanani betanki obuyifunayo.

Gcina itanki igqunyiwe, gquma imingxuma ngesikrini ukuthintela izinambuzane, kwaye ugcine uphahla, igatara ne-diverter. Gcina amanzi emvula eyahlukile kwimibhobho yamanzi okusela.

Amanzi abonakala ecocekile asenokuba namagciwane okanye iikhemikhali. Buza kwigunya lezempilo lasekuhlaleni malunga novavanyo nokucoca okufanelekileyo ekusetyenzisweni okuceliweyo.

Isihluzi esiyisiseko sodwa asiyongqiniseko yamanzi okusela. Amanzi asetyenziswa kwizityalo zokutya nawo afuna uvavanyo lokhuseleko.
keyPoints: Ubungakanani bophahla, imvula, imfuno nelahleko zichaza amanzi anokugcinwa ngenzuzo
Linganisa kwaye ugcine i-first-flush diverter ngokwephahla lakho
Amanzi acacileyo asenokuba namagciwane okanye iikhemikhali
Uvavanyo nokucoca kufuneka kungqamane nokusetyenziswa okuceliweyo

quiz.q: Ngowuphi ulwazi olufunekayo ukukhetha itanki yamanzi emvula?
options: Kuphela iphondo apho ifama ikhoyo
Ubungakanani bophahla, indlela yemvula, imfuno yamanzi nelahleko ekuqokeleleni
Kuphela inani lemvula kwisaqhwithi esinye
Kuphela ixabiso letanki enkulu efumanekayo
quiz.rationale: Ucwangciso lwetanki kufuneka lithelekise amanzi asetyenziswayo nemfuno ngamaxesha emvula nawokoma. Ubungakanani obumiselweyo bommandla omnye abunakukwenza oko.

quiz.q: Kutheni i-first-flush diverter ibalulekile nakumanzi etanki asetyenziselwa ukunkcenkceshela kuphela?
options: Ayibalulekanga ekunkcenkceshelweni, ibalulekile kumanzi okusela kuphela
Amanzi okuqala athwele ubulongwe, uthuli namagciwane agxininisiweyo anokungcolisa izityalo ezityiwayo
Anesiphekepheke esingakumbi kwaye atshintsha i-pH yomhlaba ngokuhamba kwexesha
Ithintela itanki ukuba igcwale kakhulu ngamaxesha esaqhwithi
quiz.rationale: Ukuphambukisa amanzi okuqala emvula kunganciphisa ukungcoliseka, kodwa akuqinisekisi ukuba amanzi alandelayo akhuselekile. Vavanya umgangatho wamanzi ngokokusetyenziswa okuceliweyo.

lessons.infographicAlt: Imvula iphuma ophahleni ingena emjelweni wophahla (igatara) ize ihle ngombhobho ingene kwitanki, kukho i-first-flush diverter encinci ihlukana nombhobho ngaphambi kwetanki ukulahla amanzi okuqala angcolileyo.

lessons.title: Amanzi asetyenzisiweyo ekhaya (greywater): jonga phambi kokuwasebenzisa kwakhona
lessons.body:
Amanzi asetyenzisiweyo ekhaya anokuba namagciwane, ityuwa, iimveliso zokucoca nezinye izinto. Izikhokelo azichazi umthombo ngamnye ngendlela efanayo. Izikhokelo zaseMzantsi Afrika ziyahluka malunga namanzi asekhitshini namanzi okuhlamba iimpahla.

Musa ukubandakanya amanzi asetoyilethi, amanzi eediyapha, okuhlamba umntu ogulayo okanye okuhlamba izilwanyana kwicebo lokuwasebenzisa kwakhona. Musa ukuphinda usebenzise amanzi aneekhemikhali eziyingozi.

Phambi kokuphinda usebenzise, cela umasipala nomcebisi oqeqeshiweyo wasekuhlaleni wococeko ukuba ahlole umthombo ngqo, iinkonzo zamanzi nococeko zekhaya, ukusetyenziswa okuceliweyo nendawo. Ukuba eli cebo alifumaneki okanye alicacanga, musa ukuphinda usebenzise amanzi.

Umfanekiso oqhelekileyo awuyonto yoyilo lwefama. Umhlaba nengca yokugquma azibulali ntsholongwane emanzini angcolileyo. Wagcine kude nemibhobho yamanzi okusela kwaye uthintele ukunxibelelana nabantu okanye izilwanyana. Musa ukuwafafaza, ukuwayeka ame, okanye ukuwavumela aphume epropathini aye esitratweni, kumjelo wamanzi okanye emlanjeni.

Ukuba inkqubo yokuphinda kusetyenziswe amanzi sele isebenza kwaye amanzi enuka kakubi, ayama, okanye alimaza izityalo, yeka ukuwasebenzisa kwaye ufune ingcebiso eqeshiweyo yasekuhlaleni.
keyPoints: Jonga ngokwasekuhlaleni umthombo, imeko yeenkonzo, ukusetyenziswa okuceliweyo nendawo phambi kokuphinda usebenzise
Umhlaba nengca yokugquma azibulali ntsholongwane emanzini angcolileyo
Thintela ukunxibelelana, ukufafaza, ukuma kwamanzi, ukuhamba kwawo ngaphandle nokudityaniswa nemibhobho yamanzi okusela

quiz.q: Kufuneka kwenzeke ntoni phambi kokuba amanzi okuhlamba asekhaya aphinde asetyenziswe?
options: Awalathise ngaphantsi kwengca yokugquma ejikeleze umthi
Cela umasipala nomcebisi oqeqeshiweyo wococeko ukuba ahlole umthombo, imeko yeenkonzo, ukusetyenziswa okuceliweyo nendawo
Awasebenzise ukuba abonakala ecocekile
Awasebenzise kuphela kwizityalo ezingatyiwa ziluhlaza
quiz.rationale: Izikhokelo ziyahluka kwezinye imithombo yamanzi nakwiimeko zeenkonzo zokuphinda kusetyenziswe. Kufuneka kuhlolwe ngokwasekuhlaleni ngumntu oqeqeshiweyo phambi kokuba kugqitywe ukuba ngowuphi umthombo nokusetyenziswa okufanelekileyo okanye okuvumelekileyo.

quiz.q: Kutheni kujongwa umthombo ngqo wamanzi neemveliso zokucoca phambi kokuba kuqwalaselwe ukuphinda kusetyenziswe?
options: Zonke iimveliso zokucoca zikhuselekile ukuba amanzi axutywe namanzi amaninzi
Ulwakhiwo lwamanzi nemiphumo yeemveliso iyahluka, ngoko umthombo wokwenyani neemveliso kufuneka zivavanywe
Amanzi anokuphinda asetyenziswe xa engenanuka
Ingca yokugquma isusa zonke izinto eziyingozi
quiz.rationale: Amanzi asetyenzisiweyo anokuba namagciwane, ityuwa neekhemikhali ezahlukeneyo. Nokubonakala kwawo ecocekile, ukungabi nanuka okanye ingca yokugquma akubonisi ukuba akhuselekile okanye afanelekile.
